newsitem.title: OMAN: Oman power ministry gets $385 mln extra budget.
newsitem.headline: Oman power ministry gets $385 mln extra budget.

text.p: Oman's electricity and water minister said on Tuesday the government had granted his ministry a total budget supplement of 145 million rials ($385 million) for the 1996-2000 period to boost utility services.

Mohammad bin Ali al-Qetabi said in a statement that "the authorisation of 145 million rials as a budget supplement seeks to support the water and electricity services to include all citizens and improve their lives as well as to spread social and economic development."

The projects due to be implemented to improve services in the electricity sector will include the addition of gas turbines at several power stations, he said. Other projects included a new gas power station in the southwestern city of Salalah and another in the northeastern Sur province.

He said several generators would also be transferred from the interior region to the eastern region and the Musandam province in the north of the country. A diesel power station would be constructed in the central region, he added.
A number of desalination plants would also be built in regions which suffer from water shortages, he said.
